From ba9d20ee9076dac32c371116bacbe72480eb356c Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Sven Eckelmann <sven@narfation.org>
Date: Wed, 6 May 2026 22:20:52 +0200
Subject: [PATCH] batman-adv: bla: put backbone reference on failed claim hash
 insert

When batadv_bla_add_claim() fails to insert a new claim into the hash, it
leaked a reference to the backbone_gw for which the claim was intended.
Call batadv_backbone_gw_put() on the error path to release the reference
and avoid leaking the backbone_gw object.

Cc: stable@kernel.org
Fixes: 3db0decf1185 ("batman-adv: Fix non-atomic bla_claim::backbone_gw access")
Signed-off-by: Sven Eckelmann <sven@narfation.org>

diff --git a/net/batman-adv/bridge_loop_avoidance.c b/net/batman-adv/bridge_loop_avoidance.c
index 879ab043d57a..cec11f1251d6 100644
--- a/net/batman-adv/bridge_loop_avoidance.c
+++ b/net/batman-adv/bridge_loop_avoidance.c
@@ -723,6 +723,7 @@ static void batadv_bla_add_claim(struct batadv_priv *bat_priv,
 
 		if (unlikely(hash_added != 0)) {
 			/* only local changes happened. */
+			batadv_backbone_gw_put(backbone_gw);
 			kfree(claim);
 			return;
 		}
-- 
2.34.1

**Modifications per file**

- **net/batman-adv/bridge_loop_avoidance.c**  
  In `batadv_bla_add_claim()`, the patch adds `batadv_backbone_gw_put(backbone_gw);` before the `kfree(claim);` inside the error path triggered when `hash_added != 0`. This releases the reference to `backbone_gw` that was previously acquired but not properly freed when the claim insertion failed.

**Relationships between modifications**

The change is self-contained within one function of a single file. No other files or functions are affected. The added call ensures that the refcount of `backbone_gw` is decremented consistently with how it was incremented, preventing a resource leak (backbone gateway object) when the claim cannot be stored in the hash.
